main_body: multi-story brick building with mansard roof
top_band: blue-grey mansard roof and flat roof top from row 16 to 43
evidence: Rows 16-43 show the top roof deck and pitched mansard roof slope. Row 44-45 is a distinct orange-brown cornice front edge line with a dark eave shadow at rows 46-47 above the vertical brick facade (rows 48-142), which has recessed windows and doors.

style.evidence: The building uses large, coarse bricks and heavy near-black outlines around the roof, dormers, chimney, and walls, lacking the fine per-tile and per-stone micro-texture and warm material-toned outlines of the Beodeul reference buildings.
